Description: Verify the job list page opens with its main sections

Title: Keyword box, employment type filter, Search and Clear Filters are present
Description: Verify all search controls are displayed
Test steps:
1. Open the job list page
2. Look at the Search & Filter Jobs section
Expected results: The keyword box (placeholder 'e.g. Medical Officer, Nurse, Administrative Aide'), the Employment Type dropdown ('All Types'), and the Search and Clear Filters buttons are visible

Title: Result count is shown
Description: Verify the number of jobs found is displayed
Test steps:
1. Open the job list page
2. Look under Available Positions
Expected results: A count such as 'N jobs found' is displayed

2. Type 'zzzz-no-such-job-zzzz' in the keyword box
3. Click Search
Expected results: '0 jobs found' and 'No matching jobs found' are shown
